subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The chubby player was clearly told to bring his __corpulent__ body into a good shape
solution:
The correct answer is: **Rotund**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Corpulent **means excessively fat or overweight. (अत्यधिक मोटा होना या अधिक वजन होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Despite his best efforts to maintain a healthy lifestyle, his sedentary job and poor eating habits made him corpulent.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Rotund **means having a rounded or plump figure. (गोल या मोटा शरीर होना)
 
 
• **Example**: *The jolly old man with a rotund belly laughed heartily at the children's jokes.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the player needs to lose weight to get in shape.
 
• Corpulent and rotund both describe someone who is overweight or obese.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lanky **means tall and thin. (लंबा और पतला)
 
• **Deformed **means having a disfigured or distorted appearance. (विकृत रूप होना)
 
• **Plush **means luxurious or comfortable. (आलीशान या आरामदायक)
